meta.rule: an action counts only from a subject about the company itself (ticker or company name as a whole word, the company — not another one — leading any 'Name:' prefix, no other tickers, no multi-topic digests); a rating change also needs rating-change grammar in the subject ('Upgrade to OW', 'Buy from Neutral'); a PT change needs an explicit from/to move or a PT mention; the same firm + ticker + action on the same day counts once. Notes flow = weighted e-mails mentioning the name, last 30 days vs the prior 90-day monthly average (log ratio).
